name: UtilityBar - No Chapters
description: With no chapters the strip degrades to the lede alone. Guards the trailing-separator bug: joining an empty list onto the prefix would ship a line ending in a bare middot. The two widths are deliberately IDENTICAL here, and that is the assertion: with no chapters to drop, the narrow line and the full line say the same thing. Set this pair against the derived-cities scenario, where they differ, and the compact rule is visible as a rule rather than as a coincidence of this seed.
